about: P4b fix batch 3 (review NC-6, plan 7.4 rule 17): the F of CYCL CALL POS (blockFeed) is the feed of the move to the cycle's start, for that block only. After the block it is the feed in force; the next block starts with the feed, and the feed unit word, in force before it again.

states.about: The path feed of the program.
CYCL CALL POS … F300: the block's own feed, and the cycle it runs.
The next block moves at the feed in force before the call.
A call without a feed word changes nothing.
A plain F on the call is per minute in its own block…
…and the feed per tooth is back after it, its unit word included.
Two calls in a row: each feed is its own block's.
Back to the feed in force before the first of them.
